Expand description

A simple trait for building GPOS/GSUB lookups and subtables.

Required Associated Types§

Source

type Output

The type produced by this builder.

In the case of lookups, this is always a Vec<Subtable>, because a single builder may produce multiple subtables in some instances.

Required Methods§

Source

fn build(self, var_store: &mut VariationStoreBuilder) -> Self::Output

Finalize the builder, producing the output.

§Note:

The var_store is only used in GPOS, but we pass it everywhere. This is annoying but feels like the lesser of two evils. It’s easy to ignore this argument where it isn’t used, and this makes the logic in LookupBuilder simpler, since it is identical for GPOS/GSUB.

It would be nice if this could then be Option<&mut T>, but that type is annoying to work with, as Option<&mut _> doesn’t impl Copy, so you need to do a dance anytime you use it.
